criteria.rationale: Born March 4, 1977, the patient was 49 on the September 1, 2026 request date.
The request is for chronic weight management, and the August note proposes Wegovy for obesity after a plateau on the lifestyle program.
The August 20 note documents continued diet and walking and directs the patient to continue both with Wegovy. The continuing diet is the reduced-calorie meal plan documented in January.

The structured program began January 20 with a reduced-calorie plan, walking, and coaching; February, May, and August notes document participation and follow-up. The continuous documented period through August 20 is seven whole calendar months.
The latest structured BMI before the request is 37.1 kg/m², exceeding the threshold of 30.

parsed.summary: All five modeled criteria are met. The patient is 49, has a qualifying BMI, and has documented continued reduced-calorie diet, physical activity, and more than six months of continuous weight-management program participation before the Wegovy request.
